messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Pantoprazole is a proton pump inhibitor that decreases the amount of acid produced in the stomach.
Pantoprazole is used to treat erosive esophagitis.
Erosive esophagitis is damage to the esophagus from stomach acid.
This damage is caused by gastroesophageal reflux disease, or GERD.
Pantoprazole is used in adults and children who are at least 5 years old.
Pantoprazole is usually given for up to 8 weeks at a time while your esophagus heals.
Pantoprazole is also used to treat Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and other conditions involving excess stomach acid.
Triplet: ["Pantoprazole", "decreases", "stomach acid production"]

The relation 'decreases' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug reduces or lowers the amount or intensity of the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces': The subject drug decreases or lessens the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'blocks': The subject drug inhibits or prevents the function of the biological target specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
